summary: Completed comprehensive testing of BeauGlow India e-commerce MVP. Backend APIs are 100% functional, frontend UI loads correctly with good responsiveness, but critical cart integration issue found between frontend and backend.

integration_issues.issue: Items added to cart via frontend don't appear in cart page despite successful API calls

passed_tests: All 11 backend API endpoints (100% success rate)
Homepage loads with hero, categories, trending products, testimonials
Product detail pages with add to cart/wishlist buttons
Navigation between all pages (Products, About, Contact, Orders, Wishlist)
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix cart integration issue - items are successfully added via API but not displaying in cart page UI. Check session/cookie handling and cart state management between frontend and backend.
